purpose: Explain why the frozen baseline ranks evaluation windows worse in solar cycle 25 (2022, 2023: AP 0.2800 and 0.2206) than in cycle 24 (2014, 2015, 2017: AP 0.5079, 0.4924, 0.8117). Diagnostic description only: no candidate model, no acceptance rule, no promotion.

measures.D1_composition: Per evaluation year: windows, HARPs, flaring HARPs (at least one positive window), positive windows, positive runs, positive share, median windows per flaring HARP, median USFLUX__last of positive windows and of all windows, share of positive windows whose USFLUX__last is below the cycle-24 median of positive windows, mean missing_fraction.
measures.D2_decomposition: Per evaluation year with the stored baseline probability: overall window AP; region AP (max probability per HARP against whether the HARP has any positive window: the 'which region' problem); within-flaring-HARP window AP (windows of flaring HARPs only: the 'when' problem); share of FP windows at the recall-0.90 watch threshold that come from HARPs with no positive window in the year.
measures.D3_single_feature_ceiling: Per evaluation year: AP of each of the 96 summaries and of its negation as a raw ranking; the best feature and its AP; the AP of USFLUX__last as a fixed capacity proxy. If the best raw feature's AP falls across eras like the model's AP, the information in the summaries fell.
measures.D4_within_era_fit: Per era: HARP-grouped 5-fold cross-validation (sklearn GroupKFold on HARP number, folds assigned in HARP order) of the unchanged walk-forward-v1 logistic and xgboost recipes on the era's evaluation windows; out-of-fold raw probabilities combined 0.45/0.55; AP per year. An era-internal fit sees the era's own future, so it is a ceiling for what the summaries carry in that era, never a deployable model. 2 eras x 5 folds x 2 models = 20 fits.

reading.R1_information_fell: D4 within-era AP in 2022 and 2023 exceeds the walk-forward AP by less than 0.10 in both years: the summaries carry less rankable information in cycle 25; drift of the training distribution is not the main cause and a cycle-25-aware training protocol is not justified by this evidence.
reading.R2_drift: D4 within-era AP exceeds the walk-forward AP by at least 0.10 in both 2022 and 2023: the training distribution differs from cycle 25; a separate frozen protocol for cycle-25-aware training would be justified.
reading.R3_timing_dominates: D2 region AP is at least 0.50 while within-flaring-HARP AP is below 0.30 in a year: the model finds the regions but not the day; features about timing, not capacity, would be needed.
reading.mixed: Any other pattern is reported as is, with no further reading added after results.

scope: Already inspected years, adaptive development description, not an independent test. Counts are overlapping forecast windows and groupings of them, not physical flares.
prohibitions: No new measures or readings after seeing results
No presentation of a within-era fit as deployable
